From Aqua Necklace · Price: the target must drink or breathe your stand's water or vapor.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 1 action: your stand enters a creature that drinks your water or breathes your vapor (a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-ft burst} within 30 ft; your stand enters only the creatures you choose): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1} for 1 minute (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates); on a critical failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 2} and @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] as it thrashes inside. Your stand stays inside for 1 minute or until you call it back (free action), and it can't act elsewhere meanwhile. The creature can spend 2 actions to retch it out (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} save against your stand DC; it's expelled on a success), or an adjacent ally can do so with a @Check[medicine|against:stand] check against your stand DC. A creature can attempt to retch your stand out only once per infection. When your stand is expelled or called back, a creature holding a sealable container (a bottle, a glove) can Interact to trap it; your stand can't manifest until you spend 1 action and succeed at an Athletics check against the trapper's @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} DC.
  • 5: Surge (1 action): attack from inside: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}); on a failure it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 round.
  • 9: The creature can't eat or drink while infected.
  • 13: Fog area 20 ft.
  • 17: A critical failure leaves it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
